dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Do you recall how we’ve occasionally excavated <$cdef(27)>lost relics

party venue?

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Você se lembra de como nós ocasionalmente escavamos <$cdef(27)>relíquias perdidas
Deixados por humanos?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem, o que você acha de exibi-los no
Um local para festas?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,7)>I’d love nothing more than to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(25)> those <$cdef(27)>lost relics
and discover what exactly they are.
<$comeff(1,21)><$voicel(1,10)>And by displaying them, we might help others remember
the times when humans were still here. You know—create
a nostalgic atmosphere.

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu adoraria nada mais do que <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(25)> aqueles <$cdef(27)>relíquias perdidas

uma atmosfera nostálgica.
